description: Generate catchy team names by style — funny, professional, punny, animal, fantasy or tech — with an optional keyword woven in.

faqs.a: Choose a style (funny, professional, punny, animal, fantasy, tech) and the generator combines curated word lists for that vibe.
Type a keyword and it is woven into the generated names wherever it fits naturally.
faqs.q: Can I include my own word?

faqs.a: Press Generate again for a fresh batch — combinations are randomized every time.
Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Optionally add a keyword to include.
Press Generate and click any name to copy it.
title: Team Name Generator
